purpose: Research baseline, not a parity or release certification
coverage: Initial language families plus complete headings from pinned ledger ADT and standard library API references. Not exhaustive semantic-case coverage.

baseline.qualification: Latest stable release and network matrix differ. Network qualification of 0.36.1 is not established by matrix.

evidenceKinds.SEM: Positive and negative source/type/evaluator cases against pinned documented semantics and independent expected values.
evidenceKinds.ZK: Native lowering plus official checker/prover/verifier, including adversarial witness/public-input cases.
evidenceKinds.LEDGER: Isolated ledger finalized acceptance/rejection, exact state/events, atomicity and transaction binding.
evidenceKinds.ABI: Canonical byte/value representation, bounds, argument/result schema and artifact metadata fixtures.
evidenceKinds.HOST: Same portable artifact and vectors in at least two independent host-language runners.
evidenceKinds.PROVENANCE: Pinned source/tool versions, hashes, build/dependency closure and reproducible artifact manifest.

statusMeaning.missing: No corresponding supported frontend/native route found in inspected Noctium source.
statusMeaning.subset: Some corresponding implementation exists, not full Compact feature equivalence.
statusMeaning.related-subset: Related example/primitive exists, semantic equivalence to named Compact API unverified.

features.notes: Bool values, equality, constants and constraints exist. General Boolean operators and Compact conversion semantics are absent.

implementationUpdate.scope: Published scalar semantics and native producer checks cover modular subtraction and mixed UInt/Native scalar conversions. This does not qualify every Compact field operation.

features.notes: Pinned compiler uses inclusive maxima internally. For ordinary Uint<0..m> and Uint<0..n>, addition returns exclusive bound m+n-1 and multiplication returns (m-1)*(n-1)+1. This contradicts the looser reference prose. Subtraction retains the left maximum and asserts a nonnegative result. Follow pinned implementation parity, not prose equations. Nominal aliases have separate checked-result rules.

sourceDerivedRules.appliesTo: Ordinary Uint operands and structural aliases, excluding nominal numeric aliases
sourceDerivedRules.maximumGuard: result inclusive maximum <= 2^248 - 1, checked before nominal result downcast
sourceDerivedRules.literalTyping: Literal v has minimal prefix range [0,v], not a singleton-refined type
sourceDerivedRules.declaredBinding: Declared const/parameter type controls later variable-reference inference
sourceDerivedRules.condense: Unwraps structural aliases and records nominal identities without shifting bounds
sourceDerivedRules.constantOptimization: Parameter cases do not depend on folding. expand-const splits declarations, and arithmetic inference precedes circuit simplification
sourceDerivedRules.nominalAliases: Same nominal identity and underlying type required. Result keeps original nominal type, with checked downcast when maximum grows

conformanceCases.input: Two parameters of a structural Uint<8> alias
